column3: “Even our enemies themselves judge this” renders the terse “and our enemies, judges”; the meaning is uncertain.
“vindicate” renders “judge”; “their strength is gone” renders “the hand is gone,” and “none remaining, bond or free” renders “none shut up or freed.”
“besides Me” renders “with Me”; “give life” renders “make alive.”
NASB punctuates “And say, as I live forever,” to lead into verse 41; the Hebrew reads “and I say, I live forever.”
“flashing sword” renders “the lightning of My sword”; “justice” renders “judgment.”
“the long-haired leaders” renders “the head of the leaders”; the meaning is uncertain.
NASB supplies “with” in “O nations, with His people”; the Hebrew reads “nations, His people.” NASB follows the shorter Hebrew text, without the extra lines found in the Greek.
“Joshua” renders the Hebrew “Hoshea,” his earlier name; “in the hearing of” renders “in the ears of.”
“Take to your heart” renders “Set your heart to”; “sons” renders “children.”
“that very same day” renders “on the substance of this day.”
